title: 23.57. Sanidassanattika, Atītārammaṇattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṁ naatītārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṁ naanāgatārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṁ napaccuppannārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
